Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptionally polished, production-oriented mobile strategy game screen, portrait 1080x2340, full-bleed straight-on screenshot, no device bezel. Reference image is the PREVIOUS design: preserve its beautiful floating sky kingdom art direction, ivory carved palaces, emerald glass roofs, champagne-gold trim, rich miniature foliage and turquoise waterfalls, blue clouds, high-quality stylized 3D baked lighting and crisp readable Chinese game UI. This is a redesign to APPROVED NEW GAME RULES. Replace the previous UI text and obsolete percentage controls completely. Favor readable gameplay over ornamental clutter. Premium modern casual RTS, not a marketing poster. Title exactly “连线占塔”.
TOP 16%: compact back/title/sound/help toolbar. Two symmetrical faction cards: emerald diamond “你” with “占塔 4” and “总兵力 108”; coral triangle “对手” with “占塔 4” and “总兵力 92”. Between/below cards a clean timer “02:18”. Small objective “时间到，占塔多者胜”.
BATTLEFIELD middle 64%: shallow isometric top-down view, large functional floating island. EXACTLY 13 distinct tappable buildings, arranged FIVE staggered rows of 3,2,3,2,3. All tower numbers below are GARRISON numbers. Every ordinary barracks has a separate small level tag; large dark readable garrison disk. ONE taller CENTRAL neutral ivory crown-shaped fortress in row3 center, labelled “中央要塞” and garrison “20”, NO Lv label on fortress. Neutral towers have ivory roofs and gray shield markers.
Row1 left to right: neutral10 Lv.1, red14 Lv.1, red28 Lv.2.
Row2 left to right: neutral10 Lv.1, red22 Lv.2.
Row3 left to right: green16 Lv.1, NEUTRAL CENTRAL20, red18 Lv.1.
Row4 left to right: green24 Lv.2, neutral10 Lv.1.
Row5 left to right: green36 Lv.1 SELECTED, green20 Lv.1, neutral10 Lv.1.
Thus exactly FOUR green, FOUR red, FIVE neutral including center. Draw clean connected curving stone roads between adjacent rows, enough alternate routes, paths clearly enter tower gates, NO giant roads disconnected from towers.
TROOPS: beautiful clearly visible little marching soldiers with helmets, team capes, shields and tiny shadows. Show sustained single-direction routes with repeated small chevrons sitting ON roads, not floating across mountains. Active emerald selected bottom-left36 → green24, then green24 → central20; green16 → neutral10 upper left. Three corresponding road groups total TWELVE green soldiers (5,3,4). Red28 → red22, red22 → central20, red18 → neutral10 lower right, groups total TEN red soldiers (4,3,3). Each source has at most ONE outgoing active route. Some minute sword-impact sparks at neutral tower gate, restrained dust and luminous marching trails. Keep silhouettes and troop counters unobscured. No gore. Only selected36 has the wide selection halo; other green towers don't falsely look selected. Soldier direction matches arrows.
BOTTOM 20%: refined ivory/gold integrated control panel matching reference. Compact tower portrait and text “兵营 Lv.1”, prominent “驻兵 36”. Two supporting stats “产兵 1/秒” and “自然产兵上限 40”. Route status row with arrow icon “持续增援” and small pill “留守 5 兵”. Two large comfortable buttons: ivory/dark outlined “停止出兵” and primary emerald “升级 · 20兵”. Footer exact “拖线持续出兵 · 点击城堡查看详情”. Large practical touch targets and safe bottom padding. Clean premium sans-serif Chinese UI typography, gold only structural highlights.
CRITICAL EXCLUSIONS: no percentages, no 50%, no 全部, no 本次派出, no plus/minus quantity selector, no 积分, no 占领积分, no 王城持续得分, no +1分/秒, no coin balance, no speed-up purchases, no decorative tower mistaken for 14th tower, no real company logos, no app browser chrome.
This is a still-frame art design; illustrate motion through clear posed soldiers, local effects and direction arrows. Produce the complete updated screen.

Use case: ui-mockup. Precisely EDIT the supplied newly generated mobile game design, preserving all 13 tower positions and ownership, all garrison/level numbers, beautiful ivory emerald sky-island art, UI layout, all Chinese text, top 4 towers/108 troops versus 4 towers/92 troops, and bottom buttons.
Correct ONLY troop route readability and team shapes:
1. ALL four green tower ownership emblems must be an EMERALD DIAMOND, not triangles. Red towers keep coral TRIANGLES, neutral gray shields.
2. Use these exact directed single-source routes. Green bottom-left 36 → green24 (forward and up-right); green24 → central neutral20 (up-right); green16 on left → neutral10 upper-left inner (up-right). Red28 at upper-right → red22 below-left (DOWN-LEFT); red22 → central20 (DOWN-LEFT); red18 right-middle → neutral10 immediately BELOW-LEFT of it (row4right). These are the ONLY active routes. Clear all red soldiers/active trails off the bottom-right neutral tower and the path below red18; neutral towers NEVER send red soldiers.
3. Draw little repeated arrowheads and the soldier faces pointing toward each listed destination, especially reverse currently wrong red arrows. Every active colored trail lies on the actual direct road between source and destination.
4. Represent each group as a compact animated-looking SQUAD of 3–5 visible figures with one very legible team-color number badge; logical squad counts, not the number of depicted miniature bodies. Put “×5”, “×3”, “×4” on the three green routes in order and “×4”, “×3”, “×3” on red routes in order. Badges do not obscure towers. These groups match green 96 stationed+12 marching=108, red82 stationed+10 marching=92.
5. Only bottom-left36 stays selected with wide selection ring. Other towers may have subtle team tint, not selection rings.
No other labels, map changes, extra towers, score, percentages, arrows pointing backwards or neutral-owned enemy soldiers. Preserve full portrait screen and luxury illustrative quality.

Map is DIFFERENT from the two-player map: a balanced circular sky island with THREE sectors of FOUR towers each around ONE CENTRAL fortress (3×4+1=13). Sector positions coral at top, green lower-left, blue lower-right. In every sector 3 owned towers and 1 neutral ordinary tower, interconnected via clear short stone roads; inner routes join the center and neighboring sector, symmetry of strategic distances. Exactly NINE owned towers and FOUR neutral including center.
Green sector owned garrisons36/Lv.1,24/Lv.2,18/Lv.1, neutral10/Lv.1.
Coral sector28/Lv.2,22/Lv.1,14/Lv.1, neutral10/Lv.1.
Blue sector32/Lv.2,16/Lv.1,12/Lv.1, neutral10/Lv.1.
ONE green squad marked ×6 goes from selected green36 to green24, ONE coral squad ×5 goes from red22 toward central20, ONE blue squad ×4 goes from blue16 toward its nearby neutral10. Source and targets must be adjacent connected towers. Keep center neutral; squads have not yet entered it. No violet team. Design for legibility at 390px width; generous spacing between tower hit areas.
